column1: # Top-level-test shards of internal/jobs/metrics/remaining for integration CI (CHAOS-9639).
# One `go test` of this package took 1,053 to 1,164 s on the hosted runner, 1,122 s
# when isolated in a shard of its own (CHAOS-9631): 21 of the 25 minutes of its
# job. ci/check_go.sh therefore runs the package ONLY as these name-partitioned
# shards (the same mechanism as go_queryapi_server_test_shards.tsv, CHAOS-9162)
# and never in the `packages` target. Every discovered top-level test lands in
# exactly one shard, so a new test cannot fall outside every shard.
# Weights are relative classes (integration-tagged vs ordinary), not seconds.
